[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.73, "unit": "%", "anchor": "boosting the power conversion efficiency from 23.43% to 25.73% with improved thermal stability"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The molten-salt-assisted strategy boosted PCE from 23.43% to 25.73%.", "anchor": "boosting the power conversion efficiency from 23.43% to 25.73% with improved thermal stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Molten DMTMM suppresses random nucleation and extends crystal growth period for the 2D phase.", "anchor": "Molten DMTMM serves as an excellent solvent for the 2D perovskite, which suppresses random nucleation and extends the crystal growth period, thereby facilitating the growth of a highly ordered 2D phase and reducing residual PbI 2 phase at the heterointerface", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "DMTMM passivates under-coordinated Pb2+ via its multiple ether groups upon solidification.", "anchor": "Upon solidification, the multiple ether groups of DMTMM passivate under‐coordinated Pb 2+ , further enhancing lattice stability", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "FAPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.33, "unit": "%", "anchor": "small‐area PSC device presents 26.33% efficiency with negligible hysteresis"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Small-area n-i-p PSCs with I/Br-mIm treatment achieved 26.33% efficiency with negligible hysteresis.", "anchor": "With the synergistic effects of the mixed I8C‐mImI/Br8C‐mImBr (I/Br‐mIm), small‐area PSC device presents 26.33% efficiency with negligible hysteresis", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Modified devices retained 92% of initial efficiency after 1200 h at 85°C.", "anchor": "modified devices exhibit better thermal stability by maintaining 92% of initial efficiency after 1200 h at 85°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 90% of initial efficiency after 1000 h continuous illumination near MPP.", "anchor": "The devices also retain 90% of initial efficiency after 1000 h continuous illumination with a bias voltage close to maximum power point (MPP), indicating its good operational stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "FAPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.15, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the PAH‐added PSCs achieve an outstanding power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.15%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 93.1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "20.22% for mini‐modules (93.1 cm 2 )"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PAH-added p-i-n PSCs achieved 26.15% PCE and mini-modules achieved 20.22% on 93.1 cm².", "anchor": "the PAH‐added PSCs achieve an outstanding power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.15% and 20.22% for mini‐modules (93.1 cm 2 )", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PAH increased the average grain size to 1.11 ± 0.01 µm.", "anchor": "This promotes the high‐quality crystallization of the films and increases the average grain size to 1.11 ± 0.01 µm", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Encapsulated devices retained 82.44% of initial efficiency after 1000 h MPPT under 1-sun.", "anchor": "retaining 82.44% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous maximum power point tracking (MPPT) under 1‐sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.76, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized PSC achieves a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.76% with an open‐circuit voltage of 1.184 V"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "DPMDS interlayer enabled a champion PCE of 25.76% with Voc of 1.184 V.", "anchor": "the optimized PSC achieves a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.76% with an open‐circuit voltage of 1.184 V and retains over 80% of its initial efficiency after 3000 h of storage under dry ambient conditions", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained over 80% of initial efficiency after 3000 h dry ambient storage.", "anchor": "retains over 80% of its initial efficiency after 3000 h of storage under dry ambient conditions", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.07, "unit": "%", "anchor": "A remarkable power conversion efficiency of 26.07% can be achieved for the conventional n‐i‐p structured perovskite solar cells fabricated with fresh TTB‐modified precursors"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TTB-modified fresh precursors yielded n-i-p PSCs with 26.07% PCE.", "anchor": "A remarkable power conversion efficiency of 26.07% can be achieved for the conventional n‐i‐p structured perovskite solar cells fabricated with fresh TTB‐modified precursors", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices from 7-day aged TTB-modified precursors reached 25.76% (99% of fresh).", "anchor": "devices processed from TTB‐modified precursors aged for seven days under ambient conditions can reach an efficiency of 25.76% (i.e. 99% of those made with fresh solutions)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices from 3-month aged TTB-modified precursors retained 23.88% (92% retention).", "anchor": "those fabricated from three‐month‐aged solutions retains 23.88% (i.e. 92% retention)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.32, "unit": "%", "anchor": "leading to a champion power conversion efficiency of 26.32% with a fill factor of 85.69%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "AHBA molecular bridge enabled champion PCE of 26.32% with FF of 85.69%.", "anchor": "leading to a champion power conversion efficiency of 26.32% with a fill factor of 85.69% and significantly reduced hysteresis", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Charge-carrier extraction time at the reconstructed interface was 3.5 ps.", "anchor": "Ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy reveals a charge‐carrier extraction time of only 3.5 ps, demonstrating markedly accelerated interfacial charge transfer", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained over 90% of initial efficiency after 2000 h ambient storage.", "anchor": "the target sample devices retain over 90% of their initial efficiency after 2000 h of storage under ambient conditions and exhibit substantially enhanced thermal stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.13, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the GUDHP‐modified PSCs achieve a PCE of 26.13% with an FF exceeding 85% for normal bandgap (1.56 eV) cells"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "GUDHP-modified PSCs achieved 26.13% PCE with FF >85% at 1.56 eV bandgap.", "anchor": "the GUDHP‐modified PSCs achieve a PCE of 26.13% with an FF exceeding 85% for normal bandgap (1.56 eV) cells", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Wide-bandgap (1.84 eV) devices achieved 20.06% PCE with 85.74% FF.", "anchor": "a remarkable 20.06% PCE with an impressive 85.74% FF for wide bandgap (1.84 eV) devices", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "GUDHP-modified devices maintained 93.6% of initial PCE after 1000 h under ISOS-L-1.", "anchor": "the GUDHP‐modified devices maintained 93.6% of their initial PCE after 1000 h of continuous operation under the ISOS‐L‐1 protocol", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 27.31, "unit": "%", "anchor": "we achieve champion‐certified efficiencies of 27.31% for small‐area rigid PSCs"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 27.31, "unit": "%", "anchor": "we achieve champion‐certified efficiencies of 27.31% for small‐area rigid PSCs"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 684.75, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "17.11% for large‐area flexible modules (684.75 cm 2 )"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Bisphosphonate mediator enabled certified 27.31% for rigid PSCs, 24.52% for flexible, and 17.11% for 684.75 cm² modules.", "anchor": "we achieve champion‐certified efficiencies of 27.31% for small‐area rigid PSCs, 24.52% for flexible devices, and 17.11% for large‐area flexible modules (684.75 cm 2 )", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Flexible modules retained over 94% of initial power output after 3250 h of operation.", "anchor": "flexible modules retaining over 94% of their initial power output after 3250 h of operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.33, "unit": "%", "anchor": "modified devices achieve an efficiency of 26.33% (exceeding 22.92% of the control)"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "4AA/DB18C6 hybrid interlayer yielded 26.33% PCE with Voc 1.167 V and FF 86.05%.", "anchor": "modified devices achieve an efficiency of 26.33% (exceeding 22.92% of the control) with high open‐circuit voltage (V OC ) of 1.167 V and fill factor (FF) of 86.05% (compared to 1.130 V and 80.38% of the control)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retained 93.2% of initial efficiency after 1000 h MPPT.", "anchor": "The unencapsulated device demonstrates outstanding operational stability, retaining 93.2% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of maximum power point tracking", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.7, "unit": "%", "anchor": "TTA‐modified perovskite solar cells achieve a high‐power conversion efficiency of 26.7%, with a fill factor of 85.5% and an open‐circuit voltage of 1.20 V"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TTA post-treatment yielded 26.7% PCE with FF 85.5% and Voc 1.20 V.", "anchor": "TTA‐modified perovskite solar cells achieve a high‐power conversion efficiency of 26.7%, with a fill factor of 85.5% and an open‐circuit voltage of 1.20 V", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retained 92.1% after 200 h at 70% RH and 92% after 800 h AM 1.5G illumination.", "anchor": "unencapsulated devices retain 92.1% of their initial efficiency after 200 h at 70% relative humidity, and 92% after 800 h of continuous illumination under AM 1.5G", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.90, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the inverted PSCs achieve power conversion efficiencies of 26.90% (certified 26.14%) (1.55 eV)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.14, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the inverted PSCs achieve power conversion efficiencies of 26.90% (certified 26.14%) (1.55 eV)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Dithiopyr-driven (100) orientation yielded 26.90% champion (26.14% certified) at 1.55 eV.", "anchor": "the inverted PSCs achieve power conversion efficiencies of 26.90% (certified 26.14%) (1.55 eV), 22.02% (1.25 eV), and 23.11% (1.68 eV), respectively", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "30×30 cm² large-area modules delivered 21.28% efficiency.", "anchor": "large‐area modules (30 × 30 cm 2 ) deliver an efficiency of 21.28%, which is among the highest values reported for inverted perovskite solar cells", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retained 93.1% after 3600 h ambient and over 95% after 1100 h MPPT.", "anchor": "Unencapsulated devices retain 93.1% of their initial efficiency after 3600 h under ambient conditions and maintain over 95% of their initial performance after 1100 h of maximum power point tracking", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A data-driven strategy using fragment-encoded SAMs (anchor group–linker–head group) was introduced for rational SAM design.", "anchor": "we introduce a data‐driven strategy that leverages a curated dataset of reported SAMs and their PSC efficiencies, with molecular structures encoded into three distinct segments: anchor group–linker–head group", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "The strategy focuses on recombination of fragment units rather than unconstrained de novo molecular design.", "anchor": "our strategy focuses on the recombination of fragment units, rather than unconstrained de novo molecular design", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  }
]
